properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
properties.notes: This site was allocated for residential development in Policy 10 of the made Slinfold Neighbourhood Plan. The site lies within the built up area boundary of Slinfold and adjacent the Slinfold Conservation Area. The site comprises 17 residential units (which are marketed to 55 year olds) with garages which may impact delivery. Future development would need to take these factors into account as appropriate.
